Student Union Elections Protested by ABVP Members Across India

Members of the Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad (ABVP) protested in various parts of India demanding the restoration of student union elections. In Rajasthan, ABVP members clashed with police in Jaipur and Udaipur, and some blocked the Superintendent of Police's vehicle. In Jharkhand, ABVP members demonstrated near the Chief Minister's residence in Ranchi, leading to the detention of 8-10 individuals. Similar protests occurred at Gorakhpur University during a convocation ceremony, where ABVP workers clashed with police.
